Seed-centered overlapping groups from a similarity matrix

groupSimilarityMatrix_neighborhood.Rd

For each seed s, the group is s plus every feature x with sim(s, x) > threshold (closed neighborhood). A feature may belong to several groups. Pairs with no stored value in a sparse matrix (outside rt_tol) and non-finite values are never neighbors.

Usage

groupSimilarityMatrix_neighborhood(x, seeds, threshold = 0.9, prefix = "FG.")

Arguments

x

Symmetric similarity matrix (dgCMatrix or dense) with feature ids as dimnames.

seeds

Character feature ids (matching colnames(x)) or integer column indices.

threshold

numeric(1). Strict lower bound on similarity to the seed. Default 0.9.

prefix

character(1). Group label prefix; label is paste0(prefix, seed_id). Default "FG.".

Value

data.frame(feature_group, seed_id, feature_id, sim), seed row first in each group with sim = 1, members by decreasing sim.
